intro: July 5 (Sunday) — US markets closed. Third consecutive US closure. The setup for July 6 Monday open is the most catalyst-dense single session in this 10-session framework period: NVDA Stop Day 2 determination (US close), BTC Gate 3 (IBIT) verification (US open), SPCX Day 9 volume check, SK Hynix first post-triple-holiday KRX session, and Services PMI at 9:45 AM ET. BIG DEVELOPMENT: BTC Gate 2 CONFIRMED — July 4 UTC midnight close $63,015.67 ($1,015 above $62,000 gate); ascending close structure confirmed. NVDA OTC $197.16 (above $195 stop) is the most important cross-asset signal — the market is pre-pricing Stop Day 1 isolation before the official July 6 US close. IBIT CORRECTION: prior briefs incorrectly cited an 'IBIT 5-day inflow streak.' Actual data: IBIT was in a 10-day outflow streak as of July 2 (-$40.43M); total spot ETF +$221.7M on July 3 was FBTC/ARKB-led, NOT IBIT. Gate 3 verification at July 6 US open is mandatory before BTC re-entry. This session is about VERIFYING and ACTING — not pre-positioning. Sequence: (1) 9:30 AM ET July 6 = IBIT inflow check → BTC re-entry decision; (2) 9:45 AM ET = Services PMI macro read; (3) Throughout July 6 session = SPCX Day 9 volume monitoring; (4) 4:00 PM ET July 6 = NVDA Stop Day 2 determination; (5) 9:25 AM ET July 7 = NVDA full-size add check and GOOGL/META add opportunity.

ideas.name: Bitcoin
ideas.timeframe: Gate 3 verify July 6 US open (9:30 AM ET); re-entry July 6 open if IBIT inflow confirmed
ideas.idea: Gate 1 CONFIRMED (July 3 UTC midnight close $62,579.40). Gate 2 CONFIRMED (July 4 UTC midnight close $63,015.67 — $1,015.67 above $62,000 threshold; strongest possible gate confirmation). Ascending UTC midnight close structure: $62,579.40 → $63,015.67. July 5 current $62,782.96 (-0.37% from Gate 2 close), holding fifth consecutive ascending session low. Gate 3 (IBIT) is the SOLE remaining gate. IBIT CORRECTION: IBIT was in a 10-day outflow streak as of July 2 (-$40.43M on July 2); total spot BTC ETF inflows of +$221.7M on July 3 were led by FBTC and ARKB — NOT IBIT. Prior 'IBIT 5-day inflow streak' characterization was incorrect. IF IBIT confirms positive net inflow at July 6 US open: RE-ENTRY ACTIVATED at July 6 market open. Size: 20–25% of crypto allocation. Stop: $58,100. DO NOT enter without IBIT Gate 3 confirmation — the two-gate protocol is not overridden by strong Gate 1+2 data.
ideas.why: Gate 2 confirmation at $63,015.67 is the strongest gate confirmation possible — not a thin squeak above $62,000 but a $63K full close that reconfirms structural institutional demand during a holiday-thin session. Ascending daily-low structure (five consecutive ascending session lows from July 1 $57,802) is the strongest structural confirmation in the framework period. Post-halving supply shock (450 BTC/day permanently reduced miner selling) compounds daily. Holiday-thin tape maintaining $62,000+ means genuine demand, not momentum noise. IBIT verification at July 6 US open is the institutional demand gate — if demand has rotated from FBTC/ARKB back to IBIT, the re-entry is confirmed at the most constructive point in the framework.
ideas.trigger: July 6 US open (9:30 AM ET): check IBIT net inflow data (Bloomberg ETF terminal or etf.com). If IBIT shows positive net inflow for July 3 or early July 6 flows: BUY BTC-USD at market open. Size: 20–25% of crypto allocation. If IBIT still in outflow: hold, watch, do not enter — reset to watch mode until IBIT confirms. Stop post-entry: $58,100 (14-session structural floor). Target 1: $65,000. Target 2: $70,000 (4–8 weeks). Monitor: BTC close below $62,000 on any UTC midnight session = two-close exit sequence initiated.
ideas.risk: IBIT remains in outflow at July 6 US open (Gate 3 fails — most likely under-activation scenario); BTC fades from $62,782 back toward $62,000 on July 6 US institutional return; holiday-gap profit-taking from July 3–4 weekend positions released into first US session; Services PMI July 6 disappoints (below 50 = contraction) creating macro headwind; FOMC member comments at July 6 AM offset BUY regime read

ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.timeframe: Stop Day 2 binary at July 6 US close; full-size add gate July 7 open if Stop Day 1 isolated
ideas.idea: Hold half-size through July 6 US close. OTC reference $197.16 (above $195) is the most encouraging pre-determination signal in this stop sequence — the market is pre-pricing Stop Day 1 isolation. BUT the stop is measured at the OFFICIAL US EXCHANGE CLOSE, not OTC or pre-market. If July 6 US close is at or below $195: Stop Day 2 = mandatory full exit at July 7 open, zero discretion, no averaging, no hope holds. If July 6 US close is above $195: Stop Day 1 isolated, hold through July 7 add check. July 7 full-size add requires NVDA >$200 AND SPX >7,460 AND VIX <17 simultaneously at 9:25 AM ET. Catalysts for July 6: Nicholas Parker (MSFT) named field ops head; Vera Rubin platform + NVIDIA Halos for Robotics; H200 China policy authorization ≠ revenue (first import licenses not yet issued).
ideas.why: OTC $197.16 is $2.17 above the $195 stop level — a material buffer in an OTC context that suggests genuine institutional conviction, not thin holiday-tape positioning. VIX at 15.78 (vs. the 16.0 estimate in the framework) means the macro regime is actually better than modeled going into Stop Day 2. Services PMI at 9:45 AM ET July 6 — a Goldilocks reading (51–55 ISM non-manufacturing) directly supports NVDA's demand narrative: expanding service businesses are the primary buyers of AI compute. Nicholas Parker from MSFT joining NVIDIA field ops is a leadership signal that NVDA is scaling enterprise GTM infrastructure, not just hardware.
ideas.trigger: July 6 US CLOSE (4:00 PM ET): ABOVE $195 = Stop Day 1 isolated, hold into July 7 add check. AT OR BELOW $195 = Stop Day 2 = MANDATORY FULL EXIT at July 7 open, zero discretion. July 7 add check at 9:25 AM ET: ALL FOUR simultaneously required — (1) July 6 US close >$195; (2) NVDA opens above $200; (3) SPX futures >7,460; (4) VIX pre-open <17. If any one fails: hold half-size only through Q2 FY27 earnings August 26.
ideas.risk: July 6 US close at or below $195 (any close at or below = Stop Day 2 = mandatory full exit July 7 open — most important risk); Services PMI disappoints creating sector-wide semiconductor sell pressure; China H200 import licenses NOT issued before Q2 FY27 earnings August 26 (removes primary re-rating catalyst); SPX breaks below 7,460 on unexpected July 6 catalyst; VIX spikes above 17 preventing July 7 full-size add

ideas.name: SK Hynix
ideas.timeframe: T-4 KRX sessions to July 10 ADR listing (SKHY, Nasdaq); July 6 KST open = first post-triple-holiday session
ideas.idea: Stop Day 1 ISOLATED (July 3 KST close ₩2,552,000 +10.88%). Hold half-size into July 10 Nasdaq SKHY ADR listing ($29.4B — largest ADR in history). KRX July 6 open (9:00 AM KST = 00:00 UTC July 6) is the first print in 72+ hours — the longest holiday gap in this framework period. BTC Gate 2 confirmation + NVDA OTC above $195 = strongest risk-on backdrop for the July 6 KST open since the Apple/CXMT shock. No new Apple/CXMT/YMTC news over the triple-holiday gap (July 3 abbreviated + July 4 + July 5). ADR underwriter ceiling at ₩2,723,000 (only ₩23,000 above Gate 2 at ₩2,700,000) remains the practical upside ceiling until offering price finalized. Stop threshold: any KST close below ₩2,540,000 = new Stop Day 1 (₩12,000 buffer from carry).
ideas.why: The ADR listing T-4 countdown creates a structured institutional demand clock — underwriters managing a $29.4B NYSE offering are price-stabilizing at carry near ₩2,552,000. US chip sector re-rating on BTC Gate 2 + NVDA OTC above $195 will be the first simultaneous positive signal for the Korean semiconductor sector since before the Apple/CXMT shock on July 2. KOSPI +5.76% recovery on July 3 showed the macro stabilization underway — but the full US-side demand signal (NVDA OTC recovery, BTC gates) was not yet available to Korean investors. July 6 KST will be the first session where both the NVDA OTC and BTC Gate signals are visible to KRX participants.
ideas.trigger: July 6 KST open (9:00 AM KST): monitor first 30 minutes. If KOSPI opens above 8,500 AND SK Hynix opens above ₩2,700,000 simultaneously: full-size add on July 6 KST close. If either gate not met: hold half-size, no action. New Stop Day 1 trigger: any KST close below ₩2,540,000 = reset stop protocol immediately. ADR listing July 10: monitor SKHY opening price on Nasdaq — should reflect ₩2,552,000 carry converted to USD at current KRW/USD rate.
ideas.risk: Apple/CXMT/YMTC contract confirmation published Sunday UTC (would open July 6 KST below ₩2,540,000 = new Stop Day 1 triggered); July 6 KST open below ₩2,540,000 on any new negative headline; KOSPI fails to approach 8,500 in T-4 sessions (Gate 1 unreachable before ADR listing); ADR offering priced below ₩2,700,000 (Gate 2 equivalent) signals underwriter retreat

ideas.name: SpaceX
ideas.timeframe: Day 9 volume check July 6; Day 10 Nasdaq 100 inclusion July 7; re-entry gate est. $185 July 9–11
ideas.idea: Step aside HIGH conviction — DO NOT BUY. Day 9 (July 6) is the first post-triple-holiday distribution session — this is the most important volume read of the clearance sequence because delayed sellers from July 3 abbreviated session, July 4 Independence Day, AND July 5 Sunday are all releasing their orders into a single morning. Target: below 20M in first hour (9:30–10:30 AM ET) and below 30M for the full Day 9 session. Day 10 (July 7): ~$4.3B QQQ/QQQM passive inflows from Nasdaq 100 effective inclusion — DO NOT re-enter on the Day 10 inclusion spike. IG floor buffer improved: ~$12 margin above $150 IG floor (KOSPI recovery reducing Korea-contagion tail risk materially). Reference carry ~$162. Re-entry gate: volume <5M/day for 2–3 consecutive sessions (est. Day 11–12, July 8–9) THEN two consecutive closes above $185.
ideas.why: The triple-holiday delay (3 calendar days of compressed sellers) makes Day 9 the highest-risk distribution session of the entire clearance sequence. If Day 9 volume surges above 40M (three days of pent-up sellers released simultaneously), clearance delays to July 14+ and the $185 re-entry gate moves further away. The Korea-contagion IG floor risk has substantially resolved (KOSPI +5.76% July 3, IG buffer now ~$12 vs $6.46 July 2 AH) — but this does NOT change the bond distribution mechanics. The Nasdaq 100 inclusion (Day 10, July 7) is a demand event, not a re-entry signal — inclusion buyers are systematic and price-insensitive at the Day 10 open, which makes it a poor entry precisely because distribution sellers will see the inclusion volume as an opportunity to exit at favorable prices.
ideas.trigger: Day 9 (July 6 9:30 AM ET): first-hour volume target <20M (if above 30M in first hour: Day 9 is failing clearance — extend to Day 16+). Full Day 9 target <30M. Day 10 (July 7): watch only, DO NOT enter on inclusion spike. Day 11+ (July 8+): monitor daily volume; clearance = below 5M/day for 2–3 sessions. Post-clearance re-entry gate: two consecutive closes above $185 on above-average volume. Alert: SPCX gap below $154 at July 6 open = IG floor buffer narrowed to <$4, heightened monitoring required.
ideas.risk: Day 9 (July 6) volume above 40M on negative news or triple-holiday pent-up selling (Starship incident, SpaceX regulatory item, or broad risk-off); $150 IG floor tested on July 6 open due to residual contagion or new negative catalyst; Day 10 (July 7) inclusion demand absorbed intraday, closing below July 6 close, extending distribution; bond distribution second wave post-clearance delays re-entry gate past July 14

ideas.name: Alphabet Inc.
ideas.timeframe: 2–4 weeks (through Q2 2026 earnings late July); add session July 7 open
ideas.idea: GOOGL position from July 2 open entry held through triple-holiday gap. July 6 = hold session (first post-holiday session typically sees light volume and holiday-hangover choppiness — hold, do not add). July 7 = add session: add GOOGL on any dip to $350–$355 at 9:25 AM ET July 7. Dow rebalancing systematic demand from 44+ Dow-tracking ETFs remains active through approximately Day 7–8 (July 7–8). Goldilocks NFP (119K) + ISM 54.0 = ideal ad-market backdrop through Q2 2026 earnings late July. Services PMI at 9:45 AM ET July 6 is the first macro data point of the week — a Goldilocks reading directly validates the Search and Cloud AI revenue narrative.
ideas.why: GOOGL is the only name in this portfolio that benefits from Dow inclusion systematic demand AND Goldilocks ad market backdrop simultaneously, with zero stop-protocol overhang, zero gate conditions, and zero Korea/semiconductor exposure. Triple-holiday gap creates the identical setup to the July 4 brief — holiday hangover volume on July 6 creates a below-market-hours dip that reverses on July 7 institutional return. Add session is July 7 because the July 6 volume profile will be holiday-thin and a poor entry signal; July 7 captures first-week institutional demand as managers return from Independence Day extended weekend.
ideas.trigger: July 6: hold, no action. July 7 open at 9:25 AM ET: add GOOGL at any dip to $350–$355. If GOOGL opens above $360 and no dip materializes in first hour: do not chase — wait for natural pullback within 1–2 weeks. Stop: $339 (below June 30 low). Target: $380–$390 pre-Q2 earnings.
ideas.risk: DOJ antitrust search remedies (user choice screen) reduce Search revenue before Q2 earnings; AI Mode Search cannibalizes ad clicks faster than AI ad placement compensates; Services PMI misses Goldilocks range on July 6 (below 50 = contraction signal); SPX breaks below 7,460 on unexpected July 6 catalyst

ideas.name: Meta Platforms
ideas.timeframe: 2–4 weeks (through Q2 2026 earnings late July); add session July 7 open
ideas.idea: META position from July 2 open entry held through triple-holiday gap. July 6 = hold session. July 7 = add on any weakness. META's AI ad targeting improvements compound across 3.3B daily active users with zero semiconductor supply chain exposure, zero Korea shock exposure, zero H200 China policy dependency, and zero BTC gate conditions. VIX 15.78 + Goldilocks NFP confirm the US consumer spending backdrop for sustained ad revenue. Q2 2026 earnings (late July) is the first full AI-feature quarter at scale — Llama 4 open-source flywheel and AI Ads targeting at 3.3B user scale. FCF $60B+ annual = most rate-resistant large-cap AI name in the Warsh hawkish hold environment.
ideas.why: META has NO exposure to Korean memory, NO semiconductor supply chain complexity, NO geopolitical trade risk, and NO dependency on H200 China policy outcomes. Every macro risk identified in this framework period (Korea shock, NVDA stop, BTC gates, SPCX distribution) is zero-impact on META's revenue model. Triple-holiday gap creates the same setup as July 4 — holiday hangover on July 6 may create a below-fair-value dip that reverses on July 7 institutional return. Add session July 7 is the clean institutional-flow entry point.
ideas.trigger: July 6: hold, no action. July 7 open: add META on any weakness at the open or in first 30 minutes. Stop: prior week low. Target: new ATH before Q2 earnings.
ideas.risk: EU AI Act creates unexpectedly large discriminatory compliance costs; Apple iOS ATT 3.0 restricts cross-app targeting further; Q2 earnings miss on ad revenue; SPX breaks below 7,460 on unexpected July 6 catalyst

ideas.name: Micron Technology
ideas.timeframe: 3–4 months (through Q4 FY26 earnings September 2026); entry at July 6 open on any Korea-sympathetic dip
ideas.idea: Buy MU at $1,150–$1,200 at July 6 open or intraday on any Korea-sympathetic dip. Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM story is a MICRON POSITIVE: mobile DRAM share shifting to CXMT (Pentagon 1260H blacklisted) amplifies US government AI procurement mandate for Micron's Idaho HBM4 — DoD cannot use CXMT. $50B Q4 FY26 guide confirmed; HBM4 sold out through 2026. SK Hynix +10.88% recovery on July 3 KST was not fully priced by US markets before the July 4 holiday — July 6 US open is the first session where Korean semiconductor recovery is fully visible to US investors. MU has NO stop protocol, NO gate conditions, NO ADR mechanics — cleanest AI-semi entry setup in the portfolio.
ideas.why: KOSPI +5.76% + SK Hynix +10.88% on July 3 KST resolved the Korea-contagion risk that was the primary MU negative signal on July 2. When US markets open July 6, the Korean recovery (not yet priced due to triple-holiday closure) combined with BTC Gate 2 confirmation and NVDA OTC above $195 creates the most risk-on semiconductor backdrop in two weeks. MU's Idaho CHIPS Act fab is DoD-compliant by jurisdiction of manufacture — CXMT blacklist amplification makes this MORE valuable as DoD AI procurement mandates accelerate. $50B Q4 FY26 guide is confirmed and not modeled to decelerate.
ideas.trigger: July 6 open: buy MU at $1,150–$1,200 on any Korea-sympathetic dip in first 30–60 minutes. If MU opens above $1,200 and no dip materializes in first hour: wait for natural pullback within 1–2 weeks (do not chase above $1,250). Stop: $1,100. Target: $1,350–$1,400 through September Q4 FY26 earnings.
ideas.risk: MU opens above $1,250 on gap-up (no dip entry available — do not chase); HBM demand peaks H1 2027 earlier than expected; Samsung aggressive HBM4 pricing; MU Q4 FY26 guide miss at September earnings; Korea semiconductor contagion extends on new HBM4-specific negative headline; MU NVDA-exposure correlation means NVDA Stop Day 2 (if triggered) would create sympathetic MU selling on July 7
